description.en: The Helmholtz Digitisation Ontology (HDO) provides precise and comprehensive semantics of the concepts and practices used to manage digital assets such as research data. It is developed in alignment with the practices and conventions of the OBO Foundry and released as a machine readable artifact with high semantic expressiveness. HDO is semantically top-level aligned with the basic formal ontology (BFO: https://basic-formal-ontology.org/). HDO is developed by the Helmholtz Metadata Collaboration (HMC: (https://helmholtz-metadaten.de/en).

IAO_0000116.value: Main contributors to the HDO development are credited as dce:contributor in the ontology metadata. In addition, micro-contributions (to the definition of a specific term) by people that are not main contributors are credited as dce:contributor at the term-level.

IAO_0000115.value: A schema which describes the structure of a metadata record of a digital resource.
Ein Schema welches die Struktur von Metadateneinträgen einer digitalen resource beschreibt.
An information profile which only structures the metadata deemed to be essential for a given purpose.
Ein Informationsprofil, welches die für einen bestimmten Vorgang als essentiell eingestuften Metadaten strukturiert.

comment.en: This definition is intentionally generic and broad - what is considered "core" information can vary dramatically based on application contexts and stakeholder groups. Subclasses and instances of this class can be created for particular purposes.

IAO_0000115.value: A concept which is used to denote the subject matter an entity is about.
A concept which is used to denote the subject matter of an entity and is part of a controlled vocabulary.
A concept which is used to signify the subject matter of an entity.
A concept within a controlled vocabulary which can be used as a topic of a Digital Object.

comment.en: The rules involved in data validation can concern various aspects, e.g. correctness or structure.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Spezifikation, die die Regeln für den Zugriff und die Interaktion mit digitalen Objekten in deren Umgebung definiert.
A specification which defines the rules for accessing and interacting with objects in a digital environment.
A validation during which it is determined whether some metadata record conforms to some metadata schema.
Eine Validierung, bei der festgestellt wird, ob ein Metadatensatz einem Metadatenschema entspricht.
Eine Validierung, bei der festgestellt wird, ob bestimmte Daten einem bestimmten Datentyp entsprechen.
A validation during which it is determined whether some data conforms to some data type.

comment.en: Data type validation is typically used in programming where it is assessed whether some data conforms to e.g. the rules of the data type string, boolean, list, integer or else.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein geplanter Prozess, bei dem festgestellt wird, ob der Typ oder die Eigenschaften einer Entität mit einer Spezifikation übereinstimmen.
A planned process during which it is determined whether the type or properties of an entity conform to a specification.

comment.en:
In the context of this ontologies most types of validation will pertain to data. Some other types of validation might pertain to scientific equipment or samples however. For now we intended to keep the hierarchy light and therefore did not include a specific "data validation" class which we might consider in the future if instances in this class get too heterogeneous. 
Data validation is a critical aspect of data management. It ensures that data entered into a system is accurate, consistent, and meets the standards set for that specific system. A failed validation (e.g. of a metadata record against a metadata schema) would render the entity invalid and consequently it would not be a member of the validated set of entities.

IAO_0000115.value: A digital repository which is used to define and describe data types in an arbitrary granularity and to assign persistent identifiers to these types.
Ein digitales Repository, welches dazu verwendet wird Datentypen in beliebiger Granularität zu definieren und zu beschreiben und diesen Typen persistente Identifikatoren zuzuweisen.

IAO_0000115.value: A topic which  belongs to a controlled vocabulary and represents the subject matter of a FAIR digital object.

comment.en: The class is introduced to be able to represent the topic that a digital object is about.

note.value: The potential of two different agents to work together. An agent may be a human or a machine.
Das Potential zweier verschiedener Akteure zusammenzuarbeiten. Ein Akteur kann ein Mensch oder eine Maschine sein.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Veranlagung eines Akteurs, die realisiert wird, wenn dieser Akteur erfolgreich mit einem anderen Akteur kommuniziert.
A disposition which inheres in an agent and which is realised when that agent successfully coordinates one or more of its operations with those of another agent.

comment.en: Interoperation implies that all participating agents are able to complete a joint operation based on the information they exchange. We note that communication is an essential part of the coordination of operations mentioned in the definition.

note.value: Das Potential zweier verschiedener Akteure zusammenzuarbeiten, indem sie Informationen austauschen, die mithilfe einer eindeutig definierten Terminologie strukturiert sind.
The potential of agents to coordinate their activity by referencing a common understanding or system of knowledge.

IAO_0000115.value: Interoperability which is realised when the involved agents use one or more formal languages for knowledge representation to coordinate their operations.
Interoperabilität, die realisiert wird, wenn die beteiligten Akteure eine formale Sprache für Wissensrepräsentation benutzen um ihre Operationen zu koordinieren.
A role which inheres in an entity and is realised when this entity allows data to be accessed in a planned process.
Eine Rolle, die einer Entität innewohnt und realisiert wird, wenn diese Entität in einem geplanten Prozess den Zugriff auf Daten ermöglicht.

comment.en: The accessed data is in fact a concretization of data. Please see comment in HDO_00006031 "data storage role"

note.value: The potential of agents to work together by referencing a digitised terminology that follows the FAIR principles.

Das Potential zweier verschiedener Akteure zusammenzuarbeiten, indem sie Informationen austauschen, die mit einer eindeutig definierten und den FAIR-Prinzipien folgenden Terminologie strukturiert sind.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine semantische Interoperabilitätsveranlagung, die realisiert wird, wenn die formalen Sprachen für Wissensrepräsentation (1) breit anwendbar sind, (2) FAIR kodiert sind und (3) benutzt werden um Beziehungen zu anderen (Meta)Daten zu qualifizieren.

Semantic interoperability which is realised when the formal languages for knowledge representation are (1) broadly applicable, (2) their encodings are FAIR, and (3) they are used to qualify references to other (meta)data.

label.en: interoperability according to the FAIR principles

comment.en: "Broadly applicable" as used in the I1 subprinciple of the FAIR principles is somewhat ambiguous. It may suggest either that the language for knowledge representation is broadly applied or that it can be broadly applied. In HMC we would favor that such languages are well used by at least the stakeholder communities (i.e. are a de facto standard) and that their technical quality allows even broader use. As opposed to the FAIR principles, our definitions do not directly talk about (meta)data but describe it indirectly through the inter-agent communication. Part of our rationale was that data by itself is not an agent and thus cannot interoperate with someone or something as might be assumed by the wording of the FAIR principles.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Rolle, die einer Entität innewohnt und realisiert wird, wenn diese Entität in einem geplanten Prozess über einen gewissen Zeitraum die Konkretisierung von Daten auf Hardware speichert.
A role which inheres in an entity and is realised when this entity retains a concretization of data on hardware over time in a planned process.

comment.en: "A concretisation of some data" can be read as "a copy of some data": the concretisation in the definition refers to data being a generally dependent continuant, which can have multiple concretisations at a time. If the here mentioned concretisation in a given data store seizes to exist, the data might still exist elsewhere.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein geplanter Prozess, bei dem eine Konkretisierung von Daten für eine bestimmte Zeit in einem Datenspeicher aufbewahrt wird.
A planned process during which a concretization of data is retained for a defined amount of time in a data store.

comment.en: Regarding the term "concretization" in the definition please see comment in HDO_00006031 "data storage role".

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Entität, die eine Datenspeicher-Rolle realisiert.
An entity which realises a data storage role.
Eine Rolle, die einer Entität innewohnt und die verwirklicht wird, wenn diese Entität als repräsentativ für eine andere interpretiert wird
A role which inheres in a generically dependent continuant and is realized when that generically dependent continuant indicates the existence, identity, properties, or behaviours of another entity.
A generically dependent continuant which realizes a signifier role.
Ein generisch abhängiges Kontinuum, das eine Signifier-Rolle umsetzt.

comment.en: The generic dependence of a signifier is on the entity that realizes the signifier role, not on the entity which is signified.
comment.undefined: Jos Lehmann

IAO_0000115.value: A material entity which is a whole or part of an electronic system that 1) executes commands, and/or 2) processes signals in digital or analogue form.
Eine materielle Entität, die als Ganzes oder als Teil eines  elektronisches System fungiert das  Befehle oder Anweisungen zur Verarbeitung von Signalen in digitaler oder analoger Form ausführt.

comment.de: Wir erkennen an, dass der Begriff Hardware oft in Bezug auf Computerkomponenten verwendet wird. Im Rahmen von HDO verwenden wir diese Klasse in einem weiteren Sinne, um auch Laborhardware zu berücksichtigen. In Zukunft könnten spezifischere Unterklassen wie Computer-Hardware geschaffen werden, um auch Klassen wie GPU, CPU oder HDD zu berücksichtigen.
comment.en:
We acknowledge that the term hardware is often used with respect to computer components. WIthin the scope of HDO we use this class in a wider sense to be able to also accomodate laboratory hardware. In the future more specific subclasses such as computer hardware could be created to accomodate classes like GPU, CPU or HDD. 

We also acknowledge the use of the term hardware for tools and tooling but find this meaning to be outside of the HDO scope.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein geplanter Prozess, durch den Informationen über eine Entität aus Daten abgeleitet werden.
A planned process through which information about an entity is inferred, extracted from data.

comment.en:
The output of the analysis process may either be a transformed version of the input data or created de novo during the analysis process in both cases it need to serve an information role. We also consider signifiers to be a possible output of data analysis. This is described by the following example.

During the MRI the magnetic signals are measured. These are analyzed from an image that can be considered data. Also it can be considered a signifier as only further analysis by a doctor (or a machine agent) a tissue damage can be diagnosed. In any case the output has to serve an information role for the process to be considered data analysis. In this example the input data is transformed during the analysis process in order to become informative.

note.value:
A collection of signs, signals, symbols, or other signifiers (e.g. numbers, characters in a known alphabet, strings with an assigned meaning, known graphical symbols, viewable images) which (1) represent one or more entities or their properties and (2) have been recorded in a manner that allows their transmission.

An example: A collection of numbers which represent radio waves and have been recorded on a hard drive. The numbers are the signs mentioned above. The radio waves are also signals but not the ones mentioned above.

IAO_0000115.value: OBSOLETE A generically dependent continuant which is composed of at least two datum instances.

comment.en: Colloquially, "data" is sometimes used to refer to anything that can be perceived. Here, however, we require that those sense-impressions are encoded such that they can be recorded, transmitted, and understood by at least one agent.
comment.undefined: Now inlcuded as the plural of datum.

IAO_0000115.value: A quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of the variation in that bearer's qualities or parts.
Eine Eigenschaft die ein Träger oder einer Trägerin, aufgrund der Veränderlichkeit seiner oder ihrer Eigenschaften oder Teile hat.

comment.en: For example, the self-information of the string "AAAAAAA" is null (no variation), while that of the string "ABRPGE3" is high. This is aligned to the notion of Shannon entropy, which is often derived from the probability of an event occuring: a 100% chance of an event occuring corresponds to zero information (no variation).

IAO_0000115.value: Structured data which has structuredness conforming to a dictionary specification.
Strukturierte Daten, deren Strukturiertheit einer Wörterbuchspezifikation enspricht.
Eine Graphenspezifikation, die erfordert, dass die Kanten in einem Graphen gerichtet sind.
A graph specification which requires the edges in a graph to be directed edges.
Structured data which has structuredness conforming to a list specification.
Strukturierte Daten, deren Strukturiertheit einer Listenspezifikation folgt.
A graph specification which requires a graph to use machine-actionable semantic technology to (1) describe its elements and their instances and (2) qualify the relations between them.

Eine Graphspezifikation, für deren Erfüllung ein Graph maschinell verarbeitbare semantische Technologie verwenden muss, um (1) seine Elemente und deren Instanzen zu beschreiben und (2) die Beziehungen zwischen ihnen zu qualifizieren.

comment.en: A network of real-world entities — i.e. objects, events, situations, or concepts — and the relationship between them. The content of the KG is typically human- and machine-readable. The Google Knowledge Graph is an example of a large-scale knowledge graph used by Google and its services to enhance its search engine's results.

IAO_0000115.value: A data structure specification which requires a data set to be (1) collected in a centralised manner and (2) organized in a consistent structure.
Eine Datenstrukturspezifikation, die verlangt, dass Daten (1) zentral gesammelt und (2) in einer einheitlichen Struktur organisiert wurden.

comment.en: Because of the close relationship between them, the term "database" is often used casually to refer to both a database and the database management system used to manipulate it. Here, we use the term to refer to any organised collection of data that forms the basis of some activity and the term "database system" to describe the combination of a database and a database management system. It is generally assumed that the organisation of data in a database will enhance efficiency of operations such as search, retrieval, update, and auditing. These actions are usually performed through a database management system.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Spezifikation für gerichtete Graphen, die erfordert, dass in einem Graphen keine zyklischen Strukturen mit Verbindungen des selben Typs gebildet werden dürfen.
A directed graph specification which requires a directed graph data set to not contain any graphical cycles which consist of edges of the same type.

A directed acyclic graph specification which requires a directed acyclic graph to be (1) used to represent knowledge about entities (represented as nodes) by relating them to one another with formalised logical relations (represented as edges), (2) logically coherent, such that it can be reasoned over and used for inference by machine agents and (3) constructed such that nodes further along in a path inherit all the semantic properties of their antecedents.

Eine Spezifikation zu gerichteten, azyklischen Graphen, die von solchen Graphen fordert, dass sie (1) dazu verwendet werden, Wissen über Objekte zu veranschaulichen, indem die Entitäten (repräsentiert als Knoten) mit formalisierte logische Beziehungen (repräsentiert als Kanten) verbunden werden, (2) logisch kohärent sind, so dass sie von maschinellen Agenten für Begründungen und Schlussfolgerung verwendet werden können und (3) so aufgebaut sind, dass entlang eines Pfades alle Knoten die semantischen Eigenschaften der zuvor besuchten Knoten erben.

A data structure specification which requires a data set to minimally contain (1) subject data, (2) metadata about that subject data, and (3) a globally unique identifier which, when dereferenced, allows an agent to access the data set itself.

Eine Datenstrukturspezifikation, die vorschreibt, dass ein Datensatz mindestens (1) Subjektdaten, (2) Metadaten über diese Subjektdaten und (3) einen global eindeutigen Identifier enthält, der, wenn er dereferenziert wird, Zugriff auf den Datensatz selbst ermöglicht.
Eine Datenstrukturspezifikation für deren Einhaltung die Entitäten in einem Datensatz hierarchisch angeordnet sein müssen, unter Verwendung eines einheitlichen Prinzips der Verbundenheit.
A data structure specification which requires a data set to encode a hierarchy of entities by using a consistent set of principles of relatedness.

comment.de: Eine hierarchische Anordnung von Entitäten, basierend auf ihrer Ähnlichkeit untereinander. Entitäten auf niedrigeren Hierarchieebenen müssen alle Eigenschaften der ihnen in direkter Linie übergeordneten Entitäten übernehmen. Terminologien können auch als Taxonomie strukturiert sein.
comment.en: A hierarchical arrangement of entities based on how similar they are to one another. Entities deeper in the hierarchy need to retain all the properties of their ancestors. Terminologies can also be structured as a taxonomy.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Rolle die einem generally dependent continuant innewohnt, und die realisiert wird, wenn dieses generally dependent continuant die Ungewissheit bezüglich der Existenz, Identität oder der Eigenschaften einer Entität die es repräsentiert, verringert.

A role which inheres in a generally dependent continuant, and is realised when that generally dependent continuant reduces uncertainty about the existence, identity, or properties of the entity it represents.
Eine Spezifikation, die die Strukturiertheit von ein oder mehreren Datensätzen betrifft.
A specification which pertains to the structuredness of one or more data sets.

comment.en: The data structure specificaiton defines how parts or components of a data set are arranged and relate to each other. It does not comprise information regarding the syntax that data is represented in (data format) or the serialization of how that data is stored within a system (file format).

IAO_0000115.value: A data structure specification which requires a data set to consist of a sequence of elements.
Eine Datenstrukturspezifikation, die verlangt, dass ein Datensatz aus einer Folge von Elementen besteht.
Data which encode a signifier.
Daten, die ein Zeichen kodieren.
OBSOLETE Ein Zeichen, das das Ergebnis eines Qualifizierungsprozesses ist.
OBSOLETE A signifier which is the output of a qualification process.

comment.undefined: the class is equivalent to existing class `signifier`

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Datenstrukturspezifikation, die erfordert, dass Daten aus mindestens zwei Elementen, bekannt als Punkte oder Knoten, bestehen, die durch Beziehungen, bekannt als Kanten oder Verbindungen, miteinander verbunden sind.
A data structure specification which requires some data to consist of at least two elements, known as points or nodes, that are related with one another via relations, known as edges or links.

Eine Datenstruktursprezifikation, die verlangt, dass Datenpaar aus zwei Elementen bestehen, von denen das erste eine Schlüsselrolle einnimmt, um das andere Element, welches einen Wert ist, zu finden und darauf zuzugreifen.
A data structure specification which requires some data to consist of two elements, the first of which realizes a key role in order to find and access the other element which is a value.
A data structure specification which requires some data to consist of a set of key-value pairs with unique keys.
Eine Datenstrukturspezifikation, die erfordert, dass Daten aus einer Menge von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren mit eindeutigen Schlüsseln besteht.
A role which can be realised by any digital entity when it is used to find and access another digital entity.
Eine Rolle, die von jeder digitalen Entität realisiert werden kann, wenn sie verwendet wird, um eine andere digitale Entität zu finden und darauf zuzugreifen.

comment.en: In most cases, keys are strings encountered by users and/or programme. In key-value pairs, the key is used to locate one or more values structured in a field (and optionally part of a record). Good keys unambiguously reference their fields.

IAO_0000115.value: Metadaten, welche Eigenschaften beschreiben, die Daten zu eigen sind.
Metadata which describe properties inherent to data.

note.value: Any sign, symbol, or data which reduces uncertainty about the existence, identity, or properties of (i.e. provides information about) an entity. Information is assumed to be accurate - inaccurate representation would be considered misinformation.

IAO_0000115.value: A generically dependent continuant which realises an information role.
Ein generisch abhängiges Kontinuum, das eine Informations-Rolle umsetzt.

comment.undefined: smoke that is perceived and correctly interpreted to infer the properties of a fire from which it originates (i.e. intensity, burning substance, temperature)
symbol for dangerous goods placed on e.g. trucks or on bottles in a laboratory, and interpreted to judge the properties of the containing substance (i.e. acidic, flammable)

comment.en: Note that in contrast to a signifier, information is dependent on accurate interpretation. Inaccurate interpretation of an signifier would not compromise the existence of the signifier itself, but would result in mis-information.
comment.undefined: Thomas Jejkal

IAO_0000115.value: A sequence which defines either (1) a set of nodes to be visited by traversing the edges that connect members of that set, or (2) a set of edges to be traversed in order to visit a series of nodes.

Eine Sequenz, die entweder (1) eine Menge von Knoten, die durch das Durchlaufen von Kanten, die Mitglieder dieser Menge verbinden, besucht werden sollen, oder (2) eine Menge von Kanten definiert, die durchlaufen werden sollen, um eine Reihe von Knoten zu besuchen.

comment.en: The typical unit of a graphical walk is a pair of nodes connected by one edge, but hypergraphs (with hyperedges or hypernodes) can violate that constraint, thus we omit it in this definition. Sequence can also be an empty and single component sequence, but are more commonly more than 1.

IAO_0000115.value: A graphical walk which does not traverse any edge more than once.
Ein grafischer Weg, der keine Kante mehr als einmal durchläuft.

comment.de: Im Deutschen werden Trails auch Kantenzug oder -folge genannt. Die Begriffe Wege, Kantenzug/-folge und Pfad werden in der Literatur nicht einheitlich verwendet.
comment.en: The sequence of edges can be infinite or finite. As the nodes are not distinct a node can be revisited.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein graphischer Weg, der keine sich wiederholdende Knoten beinhaltet.
A graphical walk which does not include any repeated nodes.

comment.de: Der Begriff des Weges wird in der Literatur nicht einheitlich verwendet.
comment.en: As a consequence of the limitation on the nodes, no edges are repeated either.

IAO_0000115.value: A graphical trail which is non-empty and has only the first and the last elements in the sequence of visited nodes refer to the same node.
Eine Kantenfolge, welche nicht leer ist, und in der nur das erste und letzte Element in der Sequenz der zu besuchenden Knoten auf den gleichen Knoten verweisen.

comment.en: This strict definition excludes cycles with "bubbles" in them (that is, the node that occupies the first and last positions in the sequence may be visited somewhere in the middle of the sequence too). A graph with a graphical cycle is called a cyclic graph. The length of a graphical cycle is the number of edges involved.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Datenstruktur, die Elemente (Ecken oder Knoten genannt) durch Beziehungen (Kanten genannt) miteinander verbindet.
Strukturierte Daten, deren Strukturiertheit einer Graphenspezifikation entspricht.
Structured data which has structuredness conforming to a graph specification.

note.value:
Data which are intended to contextualise or otherwise qualify other data. Examples include file size, date created, method used to generate the data and identifiers for people who worked on the data.
Metadata itself is considered data - as such data that is about metadata is per this here given definition also metadata.

Daten, die dazu dienen, andere Daten in einen Kontext zu setzen oder anderweitig zu beschreiben. Beispiele dafür sind etwa die Dateigröße, das Erstellungsdatum, die Methode, mit der die Daten erzeugt wurden, und die Identifier der Personen, die an den Daten gearbeitet haben. Metadaten selber sind Daten - daher sind Daten die andere Metadaten beschreiben - per der hier gegebenen Definition - auch Metadaten.

IAO_0000115.value: Daten, die andere Daten beschreiben.
Data which are about other data.

comment.en: Many sources conflate metadata with informative metadata, which would be more rightly called metainformation as not all metadata is informative and some may be misinformative - please refer to definition of "data" and "information". Depending of the type of characteristics being described, metadata can either be contextual or intrinsic. Richness of metadata depends on the application case, for more information please refer to the definition of "rich metadata".

IAO_0000115.value: Ein String, der (1) aus einer Zeichensequenz festgeleger Länge besteht und (2) auf einen exakten Ort im Computerspeicher verweist.
A string which is (1) composed of a fixed-length sequence of digits and (2) references an exact location in a computer's memory.

comment.en: There is an ambiguity around "location" in much the same way as "address". Here, location is used to denote the actual physical part of the device which stores data. The memory in question is typically understood as the computer's random access memory (RAM).

IAO_0000115.value: A graph which has structuredness conforming to a directed graph specification.

comment.en: The directional constraints on graph edges define ordered paths across the graph.

IAO_0000115.value: An edge with an ordered pair of nodes.
Eine Kante mit einem geordnetes Paar von Knoten.
A directed graph which has structuredness conforming to a directed acyclic graph specification.
Ein gerichteter Graph, dessen Strukturiertheit der Spezifikation eines gerichteten azyklischen Graphen entspricht.

comment.en: Some graphs contain more than one edge type. If there are no graphical cycles encountered when following graphical paths composed of edges of the same type, these are often considered DAGs.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Datenstruktur, die mindestens (1) Subjektdaten und (2) die dazugehörige Metadaten und (3) einen weltweit persistenten Identifer beinhaltet, der, wenn er dereferenziert wird, einem Akteur erlaubt, auf das digitale Objekt zuzugreifen.
Structured data which has structuredness conforming to a digital object specification.
Strukturierte Daten, deren Strukturiertheit einer Spezifikation für digitale Objekte entsprechen.

comment.en: An entity which includes attributes of an object and may also include methods that perform operations on it. TODO: needs final approval

IAO_0000115.value: Ein System, welches (1) aus verteilten Komponenten, in Form von unabhängigen Technologien und einer Menschengemeinschaft, die mit ihnen interagieren, besteht, (2) sich durch Interaktion zwischen seinen Komponenten entwickelt, aus der gemeinsame Normen und eine gemeinsame Kultur entstehen, (3) durch Selbstorganisation der Komponenten erhalten und/oder an Veränderungen angepasst wird, während sie in das System aufgenommen werden oder dieses verlassen.

A system which (1) includes - as components - distributed, independent digital technologies and a human community which interact with them, (2) develops through interaction between its components, from which common norms and culture emerge, (3) is maintained by adaptive self-organisation of its parts as they become a part of or leave the system.

comment.en: Digital ecosystems display many of the same properties of ecological systems in terms of creation, change, and destruction of niches, competition for niche space, symbiotic and predatory interactions, food web and energy transfer dynamics, etc. The definition above does not include the aspects of sustainability or scalability mentioned in the Wikipedia source, as these are both ambiguous terms and also not necessarily part of every digital ecosystem (which may be transient or have strong barriers to scalability [e.g. cost]). Further, we restrict this definition to those digital ecosystems which have human agents as parts, omitting systems that can react to the behaviours of other organisms (e.g. automated control of constructed animal enclosures or artificial habitats).

comment.en: Informally, some data stored in a computer's memory is dereferenceable when it can be accessed by a machine and, using the location information stored inside it, used to find other data or information. Once it is used in this way, it has been dereferenced.

In the context of a programming language, an abstract data type can specify basic types of data (i.e. boolean, real, char) and related stuctures (i.e. array, struct), as well as more idiosyncratic constructs.

comment.en:
Both The Research Data Alliance (RDA) and the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) Executive Board provide definitions only for a PID kernel information profile. We note that the creation and maintenance of PID information profiles is a community-centric effort. The challenge is to ensure that profiles generated by communities are recognised and parseable by repositories (or external tools). Profiles that are both recognised and well-implemented will support automated validation and indexing of PID records, allowing a wide range of operations to be performed on the metadata discovered through persistent identifiers. For HMC and other consortia, careful curation and registration of such profiles are strongly recommended, as well as efforts to encourage reuse.

Note that there is significant overlap with the class HDO_00000035 "persistent identifier kernel information profile" whose only difference to the current class is that information is deemed essential. Thus in practice individuals might be asserted to and of the two classes depending on how strict they are.

labels.undefined: The Friend Of A Friend (FOAF) ontology

comment.en: This is a broad definition of ontology that is inclusive of both digitised and non-digitised assets (e.g. a set of logical proofs on paper). Specialisations of this term (e.g. ontological graph) can be used for more semantic precision. The term "ontology" can also generally refer to the branch of metaphysics concerned with the types, categorisation, and relationships between things in the world. In this glossary, we concern ourselves only with the computational artifact that encodes some outcome of that domain. Most ontologies will have human-readable node and edge labels, as well as definitions and synonyms for the entities they represent. In this way, they may include terminology functions native to, e.g., controlled vocabularies, thesauri, and taxonomies. Further, most ontologies are encoded in RDF or an OWL serialisation, to support reasoning and querying. Definitions used may be domain-specific and consequently differ between fields. For example, consider the concept "card" which has many different meanings depending on the domain. For example, An ontology about the domain of poker would define it as the "playing card", while an ontology about the domain of computer hardware would define it as a "computer hardware card". We note that if dealing with concepts, there might be an overlap between the term ontology and the term data model.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein abstrakter Datentyp welcher spezifiziert wie eine symbolische Repräsentation (z.B. String) mit einem über die Zeit veränderlichem Wert assoziiert ist.

comment.en: This term can be defined on very different levels. On (1) an general, abstract level (2) at the level of the specification within a given programming language (e.g. "JAVA variable") (3) at the level of an instance that is used in a specific piece of code (e.g. $foo). The definition here aims at the most general level, the others can be defined if necessary. A key concept is the fact that a variable maintains its identity while the associated value may change over time (i.e. when a computer program is executed and running). How this is (technically) achieved on implementation level (on the level (2) & (3)) is programming language specific.

IAO_0000116.value: BFO 2 Reference: One major family of examples of non-rigid universals involves roles, and ontologies developed for corresponding administrative purposes may consist entirely of representatives of entities of this sort. IAO_0000115.value: A disposition which inheres in a concretisation of data and which is realised when that data can be accurately translated into another concretisation and passed through components of a machine.
Eine Veranlagung einer Daten-Konkretisierung, die realisiert wird, wenn die Daten fehlerfrei in eine andere Konkretisierung überführt und an andere Komponenten einer Maschine übergeben werden können.

comment.de: Die Veranlagung betrifft die Konkretisierung der Daten, d.h. die Form, in der sie gespeichert sind. Alle Daten sind maschinen-operabel mit einer geeigneten Maschine, welche die Daten von welcher Konkretisierung oder welchem Medium auch immer in eine andere Konkretisierung kopieren kann, wobei die Bedeutung der Daten erhalten bleibt. Eine Datenoperabilität kann unabhängig von der Art der Speicherung erfolgen (digital, magnetisch, Lochkarten). Im Einzelnen erfordert eine Datenbearbeitung zunächst deren Erfassen, beispielsweise detektiert eine Kamera beim Fotografieren zunächst Bilddaten über die Lichtstrahlen. In gleicher Weise, müssen Daten im Speicher erst detektiert werden, bevor sie bearbeitet werden können.
comment.en: The disposition is really in the concretisation of the data, i.e. how it is stored. Any data is machine-operable with the right machine which is capable of copying the data (from whatever its concretisation or medium) to another while maintaining its representational value. Machine-operability can apply to data recorded in any way (digital, magnet, punchcards). In even more detail, the processing of data always requires that it is first detected, e.g. a camera taking a picture first detects image data in the observed light rays. Similarly, data stored in memory is being detected before it is processed.

note.value: The potential of data to be processed and understood by a computer.
Das Potential von Daten, von einem Computer verarbeitet und verstanden zu werden.

IAO_0000115.value: A disposition which inheres in structured data and which is realised when a machine reads that data and performs an action directed or informed by its content.
Eine Veranlagung von strukturierten Daten, die realisiert wird, wenn eine Maschine die Daten liest und eine Maßnahme ergreift, die vom Inhalt gesteuert wird oder darauf basiert.

comment.en: The disposition is somewhat orthogonal to how deeply the machine understands the information because the machine can completely understand the content without being able to do anything about it, while it would also be possible for the machine to be able to read only a small part of the data and act upon only that part without being able to read the rest of the data. If a machine cannot read data and performs an action (e.g. closes software, produces a warning), this is not due to the machine-actionability of the data, but to a pre-programmed response for non-readable (and thus non-actionable) data in the machine.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Rolle, die einer Entität innewohnt und realisiert wird, wenn die Größe mindestens einer ihrer Eigenschaften als Referenz verwendet wird, um die Größe der gleichen Eigenschaft oder Eigenschaften anderer Entitäten auszudrücken.

A role which inheres in an entity and is realized when the magnitude of at least one of its qualities is used as a reference to express the magnitude of the same quality or qualities in other entities.

comment.en: The quality in this definition refers to physical qualities such as length, duration, weight. If qualities can be related they are neccessarily of the same physical dimension. If a unit role is realised in a process of measurement, the unit is a  unit of measurement.

IAO_0000115.value: A classification system which is used to hierarchically categorise semantic artefacts according to their semantic expressiveness.
Ein Klassifizierungssystem, das zur hierarchischen Einordnung semantischer Artefakte auf Basis ihrer semantischen Ausdrucksfähigkeit verwendet wird.

comment.en: Most common semantic resources that are put into relation in this context are (in increasing grade of semantic expressiveness) Glossaries, Taxonomies, Thesauri, Topic Maps, and Ontologies.

IAO_0000115.value: A quality which inheres in an semantic artefact by virtue of its ability to encode the meaning of data in a form that is accessible to humans and/or machines and allows inference.
Eine Eigenschaft, die ein semantischer Artefakt hat, wenn sie Wissen speichern und in einer Form darstellen kann, die für menschliche und/oder maschinelle Akteure zugänglich ist.

comment.en: The minimum level of semantic expressiveness depends on whether the entity is to be used by human or machine agents. For a human, a simple controlled list of terms can be regarded as a semantic entity as the knowledge possessed by the human can react to and reason over it. However, it would not be, by itself, a semantic entity for a machine agent, which only processes it as strings of data. Machine agents would need some form of structure to establish logically consistent relationships between classes such as synonymy, antonymy, hyponymy, and hypernymy. This can be further increased by adding axiomatic relationships with domain and range constraints suitable for machine reasoning. Semantic artifacts include but are not limited to digital glossaries, thesauri, taxonomies and ontologies.

note.value: A collection of terms.
Eine Sammlung von Begriffen.

IAO_0000115.value: A semantic artefact which comprises a collection of terms.
Ein Datensatz der aus einer Sammlung von Begriffen besteht.

comment.en:
Vocabularies in general might not always be recorded or written down explicitly -  within the scope of HDO, this is seen as a sematic artefact and therefore data.within the scope.
Vocabularies are arbitrarily bounded, but are often restricted to a discipline or area of interest. Technically a vocabulary can consist of 2 terms or more.

note.value: Ein Leitfaden, der eine Reihe von Schritten beschreibt, welche im Umgang mit Daten erforderlich sind, um eins oder mehrere Ziele zu erreichen. Im Falle von wissenschaflichen Daten legt ein Datenmanagementplan fest, welche Maßnahmen ergriffen werden sollen um sicherzustellen, dass diese Daten, während und nach einem Projekt, dokumentiert, auffindbar, zugänglich und wiederverwendbar sind.

A guide describing a series of steps needed to handle data to meet one or more aims. For research data, a data management plan specifies what measures will be taken throughout and often beyond a research project to ensure that its data is well documented, findable, accessible, and reusable.

IAO_0000115.value: A plan specification pertaining to the handling of data.
Eine Planungsspezifikation, die Ziel- und Handlungsvorgaben umfasst, die den Umgang mit Daten betreffen.

comment.en: Data management plans often conform to standardised templates, however, many are ad hoc or informal.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein Objekt, welches genau zwei Elemente enthält, die eine feste Abfolge haben.
A list which contains exactly two elements in a fixed order.

comment.en: Exchanging one or both elements or changing the order would result in a different object.

note.value: A vocabulary which only includes terms that have been deliberately selected by its creators or maintainers.
Ein Vokabular, welches nur Begriffe enthält, die durch die Verantwortlichen gezielt ausgewählt wurden.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein Vokabular, welches nur Begriffe enthält, die mit Absicht durch die Verantwortlichen ausgewählt wurden.
A vocabulary which only includes terms that have been deliberately selected by its authors and/or maintainers.

comment.en: The methodology used to construct a controlled vocabulary should be documented to verify that the term collection is indeed controlled by it. Controlled vocabularies should address the issues with homographs, synonyms and polysemes by a bijection between concepts and authorized terms. In short, controlled vocabularies reduce ambiguity inherent in normal human language where the same concept can be given different names and ensure consistency.

IAO_0000115.value: An abstract representation of an entity which (1) is based on a substantial collection of information, (2) grants its bearer reliable familiarity with that entity, and (3) can be used to reason and take action about that entity.

Eine abstrakte Abbildung einer Entität, die (1) aus umfangreichen Informationen aufgebaut ist, (2) ihrem Träger eine zuverlässige Vertrautheit mit dieser Entität gewährt und (3) dazu verwendet werden kann, Überlegungen und Schlussfolgerungen über die Entität zu ziehen und diesbezüglich zu handeln.

comment.en: For example, an expert with knowledge about the salinity range of the Arctic Ocean (constructed from large amounts of information on the topic would be able to reason that a salinity value of 43% is a likely error, rather than a real measurement. We note that the term 'abstract representation' used in this definition should not be confused with the term 'knowledge representation' that is used in the field of artificial intelligence and computer reasoning and typically is a formalised form of knowledge.

note.value: Ein Sammlung von Begriffen mit den dazugehörenden Erläuterungen zu deren Bedeutung (ihre Glosse).
A collection of terms with corresponding explanations of their meanings (i.e. their glosses).

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Terminologie, die Begriffe mit Erläuterungen zu ihrer Bedeutung (ihren Glossen) verbindet.
A terminology which associates terms with explanations of their meanings (i.e. glosses).
Wissen, das in für Maschinen lesbarer und verwendbarer Form codiert wurde.
Knowledge, which has been encoded in a machine-readable and actionable form.

note.value: Ein Vokabular, in dem die Begriffe so angeordnet sind, dass sie in einer bestimmten Beziehung zueinander stehen, z. B. durch hierarchische Verschachtelung, um um die weitere oder eingeschränkte Bedeutung der Begriffe darzustellen.
A vocabulary in which terms are arranged to represent some relationship between them, e.g. hierarchical nesting, to indicates broader or narrower meanings of terms.

IAO_0000115.value: A vocabulary which is structured.
Ein Vokabular, das strukturiert ist.

comment.en: Please see the definition of "structure". Note that the mentioned structure does not necessarily reflect strict semantic relationships, as it may simply be functional (for a user interface) or convenience grouping. Relations may be encoded as simple as whitespace indentation in a list, or in more complex forms using RDF predicates. The structure could be defined by additional syntax around the terms such as OWL restrictions or SKOS assertions - it can differ depending on implementation. IAO_0000115.value: Eine Eigenschaft, die Daten haben, wenn (1) ihre Nutzung keinen monetären, technischen oder sonstigen Beschränkungen unterliegt, (2) sie in einem Repositorium gehostet werden, das den freien Download der Daten, bzw. Teile dieser über das Internet ermöglicht, (3) die Daten alle für die Einhaltung der Lizenzbestimmungen erforderlichen Informationen enthalten und (4) Zugang zu sowie Änderungen einzelner Komponenten dieser Daten einfach möglich ist.

A quality which inheres in data, by virtue of (1) the absence of restrictions - monetary, technical, or otherwise - upon their use, (2) the data being hosted in a repository which allows, in whole or in part, the free access to them, (3) the data containing all information required for license compliance, and (4) the data being serialised in such a way as to readily allow identification of, access to, and modification of their parts.

comment.en: We might need a separate definition for "open" that also applies to entities like software (could be data) and license (or "license openness"). We note that the term "open" is used in various fields with differing meanings. While the given definition here is applicable to terms, such as open data (for research data) or open-source software (for program code), it should be differentiated from the meaning of the term open access (in publishing). The latter has fewer constraints with respect to e.g., hosting, format and re-use. The absence of legal restriction for re-use can be ensured by making sure that the data or software in question as well as the format it is stored in are under a license specifying permission to re-use and modify, such as e.g. CC-BY. The requirements to cite the source are not seen as a restriction on re-use or modification in the sense of the given definition here. Covering reasonable one-time reproduction costs (e.g., fees to cover the costs when ordering a physical medium containing the requested data or software) is not seen as a monetary restriction in the sense of this definition.

note.value: Eine Vorlage, die zeigt, wie Metadaten strukturiert und gespeichert werden sollten.
A template which shows how metadata is to be structured and stored.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein Schema, dass die Struktur von Metadaten beschreibt.
A schema which represents or constitutes the structure of metadata.

comment.en: A metadata schema is used to (pre-)define the structure of metadata. For example, the arrangement of fields in a BibTex template constitutes a metadata schema to be used by a reference management system. Note that the term "metadata standard" is not a exact synonym of "metadata schema", even though these terms are often used interchangeably. Not all schemata are standardised and not all metadata standards are schemata, however one could have a standard metadata schema.

IAO_0000115.value: Strukturierte Daten, deren Strukturiertheit einer Taxonomiespezifikation entspricht.
Structured data which has structuredness conforming to a taxonomy specification.

comment.de: Eine hierarchische Unterteilung von Objekten, basierend auf ihrer Ähnlichkeit.
comment.en: Entities deeper in the hierarchy need to retain all the properties of their ancestors. Terminologies can also be structured in taxonomy.
comment.undefined: Need to be revised to differentiate taxonomical data from taxonomy itself

note.value: Ein Wort oder ein Ausdruck, der mit einer Bedeutung assoziert wird die etwas oder jemanden beschreibt.
A word or phrase which is associated with a meaning intended to describe something or someone.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Zeichenfolge, die mit einer Bedeutung assoziiert ist.
A string which is associated with a meaning.

comment.en: Terms can be single words or multi-word phrases.

IAO_0000115.value: A generically dependent continuant which is composed always of multiple data instances, which are grouped intentionally according to one or more common characteristics.
Ein generisch abhängiges Kontinuum, welches immer aus mehreren Daten besteht, die aufgrund einer oder mehrerer gemeinsamer Merkmale mit Absicht zusammengestellt wurden.

comment.en: Intention may be related to analysis, storage or publication of that data(set). For example, all files that are stored together on one CD-ROM or DVD might constitute a dataset as they are stored physically together. The organisation of the collection might strongly differ between application cases.
comment.undefined: Jos Lehmann

note.value: Ein Vokabular, das Begriffe enthält, die innerhalb einer Disziplin verwendet werden.
A vocabulary which includes terms used within a community or a discipline.

IAO_0000115.value: A vocabulary which is composed of terms used in a domain of knowledge.
Ein Vokabular, das sich aus Begriffen zusammensetzt, die in einem Wissensgebiet verwendet werden.

comment.en: Because "terminology" also pertains to the study of terms, it's sometimes used as a broad class to refer to thesauri, ontologies, etc as they are often the output of this study.

IAO_0000115.value: A database system which has (1) been optimised to support a defined set of analyses and (2) stores data in a predefined structure using standards and conventions.

Ein Datenbanksystem, das (1) zur Unterstützung einer bestimmten Reihe von Analysen optimiert wurde und (2) Daten in einer vordefinierten Struktur unter Verwendung von Standards und Konventionen speichert.

comment.en: In the design process of a DW the purpose of the DW should be at its core. This differentiates it from a generic database which could be multi-purpose or simply used for storing structured data without a specific application in mind (e.g. for creating analytical reports, real time operational reporting).

IAO_0000115.value: A digital repository which is centralised and allows the storage of data as-is.
Ein digitales Repository, welches zentralisiert ist und die Speicherung von Daten im Ist-Zustand ermöglicht.

comment.en: In this context, "centralised" suggests that - from the user perspective - the repository behaves as a cohesive whole and that there is a single point of access. Data stored in the data lake does not have to conform to any pre- defined schema, and may be structured or unstructured. Users can pull arbitrary data from the data lake for downstream purposes, but will likely have to curate or modify it to be suitable for cross-comparison or other downstream actions A data lake usually prioritises the preservation of large quantities of data (over, for example, curating it to a high standard of interoperability) and make it available for further processing downstream, if desired. Hosted data might be e.g. raw copies of source system data, sensor data, etc.

note.value: A terminology in which terms are associated with their synonyms and antonyms.
Eine Terminologie, in der Begriffe mit ihren Synonymen und Antonymen in Beziehung gesetzt werden.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Terminologie, die Begriffe auf der Grundlage ihrer Synonymie oder Antonymie miteinander in Beziehung setzt.
A terminology which relates terms to one another based on their synonymy or antonymy.

comment.en: Thesauri often use types of synonymy or antonymy to relate terms to one another, and are often digitally encoded in SKOS. Thesauri may or may not include definitions, in which case they include a glossary as a part.

IAO_0000115.value: Software which communicates between users and system software to direct hardware operations.
Software, die zwischen dem Benutzer und der Systemsoftware kommuniziert, um den Betrieb der Hardware zu steuern.

comment.en: When using a computer users might not be aware that their actions guide hardware operations. Hardware operations include the operation of RAM or the CPU. Hardware operation can thus be considered unavoidable when operating a computer. IAO_0000115.value: Eine Eigenschaft die Daten haben, wenn sie ausreichend informativ für die Durchführung eines, oder mehrerer, definierter geplanter Prozesse sind.
A quality which inheres in data, by virtue of that data being sufficiently informative to support the completion of one or more planned processes.

comment.en: The term "rich metadata" is often used loosely, e.g. in the descriptions of the FAIR (sub)principles. We note that the "richness" of metadata is depending on the aims, criteria, and capabilities of the agents that would use it. As such, metadata can only be labelled as "rich" when the complete (or at least a representative) set of use cases, it will be subject to, is known - along with their specifications. Even in the latter case, new (re)uses of the metadata, unknown at the time at which metadata is generated or gathered, can easily arise. Thus it is generally recommended to gather and record all feasible metadata as much as possible. These metadata may cover contextual factors, data structure, administrative aspects, provenance, or/and the results of analyses performed upon the metadata or its associated data. We note that in the case of the FAIR (sub)principles, the richness of metadata is specifically required to realise the findability and reusability or related data. Being informative is a quantitative measurable attribute. Please refer to the definition of information in this glossary for further information.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein Werkzeug, welches Metadaten erstellen und/oder verabeiten kann.
A tool which can generate and/or manipulate metadata.

comment.en: TODO: ongoing discussion at https://gitlab.hzdr.de/hmc/hmc/cct-7-semantics/hmc-glossary-initialization/-/merge_requests/61/diffs#82954dcd4b7d149e4f52b3a0df51f3e2cb416c4b

IAO_0000115.value: Ein Dienst, der über eine Schnittstelle im World Wide Web angeboten wird.
A service that is offered via an interface in the world wide web.

comment.en: A web service is typically a software system designed to support interoperable machine-to-machine interaction over a network. The interface could either be a GUI or an API which is described in a machine-processable format. note.value: Anweisungen, die in einem Programm, Skript oder einer anderen symbolischen Form kodiert sind, und die, wenn sie ausgeführt werden, Hardware anleiten, was zu tun ist.
Instructions which are encoded in a program, script, or another symbolic form and which, when executed, tell hardware what to do.

IAO_0000115.value: An action specification whose concretisations direct the actions of hardware.
Eine Aktions-Spezifikation, deren Konkretisierungen die Aktionen von Hardware steuern.

comment.en: Software can be implemented in multiple computer languages. We use this as a top-level class to accommodate both ad-hoc scripts which have a more sequential nature, as well as engineered software which has a higher degree of nestedness, usually includes more formal planning and employs rigorous unit and beta testing during implementation. IAO_0000115.value: A persistent unique identifier which has had its uniqueness verified against a globally authoritative registry.
Ein eindeutiger, persistenter Identifier, dessen Eindeutigkeit durch den Abgleich mit einer Registry sichergestellt wurde, die globale Autorität hat.

comment.en: This is the ideal PID to realize FAIRness. In general, it is expected that - once created - a persistent unique identifier will be stored in the globally authoritative registry it is verified against. The registry will then prevent duplication of the persistent unique identifier as new identifiers are added.

note.value: Die Eigenschaft von Daten, wenn sie entsprechend der FAIR-Prinzipien auffindbar, zugänglich, interoperabel und wiederverwendbar sind.
The property of data, if they are findable, accessible, interoperable and re-usable according to the FAIR principles.

IAO_0000115.value: A quality which inheres in data, by virtue of that data having the dispositions of findability, accessibility, interoperability and re-usability according to the FAIR principles.
Eine Eigenschaft, die Daten haben, wenn sie die Veranlagungen zur Auffindbarkeit, Zugänglichkeit, Interoperabilität und Wiederverwendbarkeit gemäß den FAIR-Prinzipien aufweisen.

comment.en: We note that, an absolute measure for FAIRness is not possible. This is because FAIRness will always depend on specific application cases or operational environments. The FAIR Principles are, after all, high-level principles. Several projects have implemented quantitative and semi-quantitative measures of FAIRness, but these measures also require specific implementations and/or interpretations of the FAIR Principles. While some aspects of the FAIR principles can be measured in absolute terms (i.e. is there a PID?) others (i.e. is the metadata rich?) require advanced foreknowledge of a representative sample of possible application cases.

note.value: The encoded form of instructions according to the rules of a given programming language.
Eine kodierte Form von Anweisungen, die einer bestimmten Programmiersprache folgt.

IAO_0000115.value: Ein narratives Objekt, in dem alle Aussagen den Regeln einer Programmiersprache folgen.
A narrative object in which all propositions adhere to the rules of a programming language.
A role which inheres in an entity and is realized when that entity is used to represent a single element of a set or a part of a whole.

comment.en: The definition provided here allows for flexibility to address that code can be concretised in multiple data types (e.g. program code, markdown) and file formats. IAO_0000115.value: Eine Zeichenfolge, die (1) Teil eines Dateinamens ist und (2) bei der Bearbeitung durch eine Maschine auf das Dateiformat deutet.
A string which (1) is part of a file name and (2) indicates the file format.
Software, die eine Plattform für andere Software bietet, so dass sie gemeinsam als ein ein zusammenhängendes System arbeiten kann.
Software which provides a platform for other software such that they can operate collectively as a single coherent system.

note.value: Das Potential von Daten zur Wiederverwendung, das davon abhängt, wie umfangreich sie mit exakten, standardisierten Metadaten, einschließlich Informationen zur Lizenz und Provenienz, beschrieben sind.
The potential of data to be reused, based on how richly they are annotated with accurate, standardised metadata including licensing and provenance information.

IAO_0000115.value: Wiederverwendbarkeit von Daten, deren Metadaten (1) umfangreich sind, den gängigen Standards der jeweiligen Community entsprechen, eine detailliert dokumentierte Provenienz haben und auf eine eindeutige und zugängliche Datennutzungslizenz verweisen, und (2) - ganz oder teilweise - dazu verwendet werden, eine mehrfache, korrekte und autorisierte Nutzung dieser Daten zu ermöglichen.

Reusability which inheres in data whose metadata (1) are rich, comply with community standards, are associated with detailed provenance, and include links to a clear and accessible data usage license, and (2) are used - in whole or in part - to facilitate multiple, valid, and authorised uses of that data.

label.en: reusability according to the FAIR principles

note.value: Das Potential von Daten, einfach und ohne weitere Umstände mehr als einmal verwendet zu werden. Je besser diese nachgenutzt werden können, desto diverser sind die möglichen Anwendungen, zum Beispiel in anderen Systemen oder Disziplinen.
The potential of data to be easily and readily used more than once. The more reusable data are, the more diverse the reuse of that data can be, for example in different systems or disciplines.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Veranlagung, die Daten haben können und die realisiert wird, wenn sie mehr als einmal korrekt verwendet werden.
A disposition which inheres in data and which is realised when they are validly used more than once.

comment.en: This definition is for the reusability of data in a general sense. A more specific situation applies to reusability according to the FAIR principles which is defined elsewhere.

IAO_0000115.value: System software which manages the operation of a specified range of hardware.
Systemsoftware, die den Betrieb bestimmter Hardware verwaltet.

comment.en: The here specified range of hardware pertains to the typical sets of hardware comprised in a computer (e.g. CPU, motherboard, RAM, GPU, sound card). By operating these components an operating system provides common services for application software towards these components. note.value: Eine Liste von Anforderungen, die Daten erfüllen müssen, um auffindbar, zugänglich, interoperabel und wiederverwendbar zu sein. Dadurch werden die Daten langfristig für Menschen und maschinelle Agenten wiederverwendbar und somit nachhaltig nutzbar.

A set of requirements that data properties needs to fulfill in order for the data to be findable, accessible, interoperable and re-usable. Thereby the data will be re-usable for humans and machine-agents in the long-term and thus be sustainable.

IAO_0000115.value: Eine Ziel-Spezifikation, die (1) die Anforderungen definiert, die eine digitale Entität erfüllen muss, um als auffindbar, zugänglich, interoperabel und wiederverwendbar zu gelten und die (2) wenn diese erfüllt sind, eben jene Entität zu der Gruppe der digitalen FAIR-Entitäten zählt.

An objective specification which (1) defines requirements for a digital entity to be considered findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable, and (2), when fulfilled, considers that entity to be a member of the group of FAIR digital entities.

comment.en: See definitions of findability, accessibility, interoperability, and reusability.

note.value: Die Vorgeschichte einer Entität, die alle Vorgänge umfasst, die mit dem Ursprung, den Eigentumsrechten, der Aufbewahrung, dem Standort und der Veränderung dieser Entität zusammenhängen.
The history which is the sum of those processes relating to the origin, ownership, custody, location, and modification of an entity.

IAO_0000115.value: A history which is the sum of those processes relating to the origin, ownership, custody, location, and modification of an entity.

comment.en: In many cases, cloud-based systems are accessible via the internet. 2014-03-31: In the example of usage ("In the protocol of a ChIP assay the objective specification says to identify protein and DNA interaction") there is a protocol which is the ChIP assay protocol. In addition to being concretized on paper, the protocol can be concretized as a realizable entity, such as a plan that inheres in a person.
